positions.commentary: The speaker admits that moving on from Amazon after it went from $10 to $14 was a very dumb mistake that got blown away.
The speaker mentions that Nick Sleep put all his money in Berkshire, Costco, and Amazon after shutting down his fund, and he outperformed anyone else.
The speaker mentions Coke and Amex as examples of businesses with long runways that Buffett had done well with, but does not mention Google.
